128/1000/1.42.input_deck:
variable        NSTEPS          equal 300000
variable        THERMO_FREQ     equal 100
variable        DUMP_FREQ       equal 100
variable        TEMP            equal 1000
variable        TAU_T           equal 0.10000
units           metal
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic
atom_modify map yes
newton on

neighbor        1.0 bin

#read_restart    restart.hydrogen
read_data        init.lmp
mass            1 1.000000
velocity all create ${TEMP} 4928459 dist gaussian mom yes rot yes
pair_style mace no_domain_decomposition
pair_coeff * * /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ogl/rogl001/giacomo/MODEL_llt_IT4/train_solid_mod_pst1.8/MACE_hydrogen_swa.model-lammps.pt  H 

thermo_style    custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol lx ly lz xy xz yz
thermo          ${THERMO_FREQ}
dump            1 all custom ${DUMP_FREQ} traj/*.lammpstrj id type xu yu zu fx fy fz
restart         10000 hydrogen.restart

fix             1 all temp/csvr ${TEMP} ${TEMP} ${TAU_T} 12345 
fix 		2 all nve
reset_timestep  0
timestep        0.000200
run             ${NSTEPS} upto

jobs.start: read_data init.lmp
